source_commits.scope: Local plan/goal/nap/travel dirty exits and nap schedule date retention
Milestone contribution review from actual eligible saved evidence

emulator: disposable API36 only; host audio disabled

scope.GoalFlowTest: Real local drafts, Keep/Discard and recreated reviews, explicit plan save/goal start/stop; private plan preferences and record DB; reminder delivery replaced by counter. Real production preferences/database unchanged.
scope.NapFlowTest: Two existing methods only, not the third portable-metadata method. Real draft selection/Back/recreation, typed schedule date, timer persistence/cancel/retry and view-only supporting child/help navigation; private DB/clock and injected schedule/fire/audio ports (no real audio or alarms); untouched sentinel/private backup and production preference checks.
scope.TravelPlanFlowTest: Real zone/date/reminder drafts, Keep/Discard/recreated/stale review controls, explicit save, receiver duplicate/rearm/failure/retry and disable; private preferences/clock and injected schedule/cancel/show port. Production preferences unchanged.
scope.RecordAchievementsFlowTest: Real private saved-record reader, min-three-hour/non-nap/unique measured contribution basis, linked record/report return, first/seven/thirty basis, recreation/error/retry; actual edit/search assertions retained. Fixture records are not user measurements.

capture_contract: Every listed original is emitted by an unconditional capture call reached by the selected existing method on success, including its supportingNavigation helper. Captures use the actual focused native window/frame and UiDevice.takeScreenshot. Failure-only PNG/XML diagnostics are excluded from required success originals. No screenshot replay, synthesized image or new test method. ciReview=true is passed for this cohort; Nap/Travel/Achievements explicitly assert it, Goal retains its existing isolated-state preflight.
limits: Focused families 29-31 local-flow and 29D milestone cohort only; not acceptance of all 43 Night Dial families. No phone, capture, playback, OS alarm, model evaluation or broad/unit campaign. Requires exact merged verification source, successful five-method instrumentation logs, all original PNGs and visual inspection. Historical source 351b78bf/run 41212354914 images are comparison only.
